LanguageData.RR_Setup_Introduction: Your selected people and supplies are retained. Company roles are editable assignments, not changes to pawn kinds, skills, traits, health, relationships or equipment. Capability warnings are advisory; missing capabilities may require hiring, training or different assignments before operations. Use Back to change people or supplies.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_InvalidRoster: Select 1–20 distinct, living humanlike starting people. No extra people will be silently removed to fit this boundary. Use Back to adjust your selected roster.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_InvalidTile: Select a valid surface starting tile before reviewing the company.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_InvalidConfiguration: The company startup definition is incomplete or invalid. Review the game log before starting; no people or supplies have been granted.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_StaffCount: Selected staff: {0}. Other native optional candidates are not starting staff.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_Funding: Company allocation: ${0}. Daily wage per starting staff member: ${1}; daily overhead: ${2}. Physical supplies are listed separately.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_LimitedCapacity: Advisory: this person is downed or has limited movement/manipulation. Their existing health is preserved.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_NoViolence: Advisory: this person cannot perform violent work.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_DisabledWork: Advisory: {0} work is disabled for this person.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_AdvisorySkill: Suggested role qualification: {0} {1}. This skill will not be raised automatically.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_Supplies: Editable native starting supplies and scenario conditions
LanguageData.RR_Setup_Facility: Fixed prebuilt facility — separate from editable carried supplies
LanguageData.RR_Setup_FixedInfrastructure: Layout sections: {0}; ordinary structure doors: {1}; conduit runs: {2}. Walls, floors, roofs and these conduits are part of this fixed facility.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_FixedFuel: {0}: starts with {1} of its fuel capacity, separate from loose starting fuel.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_FixedCapacity: The facility and food defaults do not expand with the roster. Build extra beds and arrange additional supplies for larger teams. A standard first expedition needs three field crew plus a separate headquarters operator; smaller starts can hire before dispatch. Native startup assigns initial Work settings; company roles do not overwrite them.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_Confirm: I have reviewed this roster, its advisory capability gaps, physical supplies and fixed facility.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_NeedsReview: Review the selected people, supplies and fixed facility, then acknowledge this page before starting.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_Unaccepted: The selected roster, company roles or tile changed after final review. Return to company setup and review them again before starting.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_ArrivalIncomplete: Native company arrival did not finish. The saved receipt prevents a second supply grant. Preserve the map and log; return to setup for a new campaign if a selected person failed to arrive.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_UnknownReceipt: This headquarters receipt belongs to an unsupported setup version. Preserve the save and use the matching build; initialization will not replay physical grants.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_Welcome:
Your selected people have arrived and the branch allocation is recorded.
Native starting supplies are near the arrival point, and equipped or carried items stay with their owners. The fixed facility is separate from those supplies.
Review Operations, assign a capable operator, complete the gate and prepare a real return route. A small or underqualified roster may need recruitment or training first.
Native Work, Research, Architect and pawn controls all remain available.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_CompanyName: Company name. This is your company; call it whatever you like.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_DrawFault:
This page could not finish drawing: {0}
The rest of the company review is unavailable, but Back and Start both still work. Please report this text.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateHeading: Bringing a gate up, and whether this branch arrives able to
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateCost: The assembly bill wants {0}, carried to the bench and worked by a crafter. Check the starting supplies below for them.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_CompanySupplies: Starting supplies the company adds to this start
LanguageData.RR_Setup_SuppliesDiffer: The starting equipment in play differs from the company's own list above, so another setup mod is managing it. What arrives is the list directly above this line; edit it there if the gate materials are missing.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateNoRecipe: The gate assembly recipe is missing from this build, so no gate can be assembled. This is a fault, not a setting.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateNeedsDoor: a door to designate as the gate
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateNeedsBench: a {0} to run the assembly on
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateNeedsConsole: a communications console for the operator to stand at
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateNeedsBattery: a battery to hold the return reserve
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateAbsent: NOT here: {0}. You will have to build or buy one.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateReady: Everything a gate needs is already standing. Designate the door, console, battery and bench on Operations' Machine pane, then run the assembly bill.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateNotReady: This branch is in contact and holds the gate research, but is missing hardware: {0}. Build it or order it from the company before an opening is possible.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateLaterWork: A built gate is later work for this opening, not a missing piece of it. Not here yet: {0}.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateContactRoute: This branch starts outside company contact and with no gate research finished, so it is not meant to assemble one yet. There is already a way through that nobody built. Reach the corporation, research what a gate needs, then order the equipment.
LanguageData.RR_Setup_GateInsideRoute: This opening begins inside the Backrooms, outside company contact and with no gate research finished. Finding a way out comes first; ways through that nobody built reach only so deep, and going further needs a gate you have earned the right to build.
